note: hashes of the raw gate output, which stays in job tmp (tmp/p3/gate-run/out). Every non-private file outside snapshots/, pbc-rpc/ and dbc-rpc/ is listed with its sha256; each snapshots/, pbc-rpc/ and dbc-rpc/ directory is one aggregate: file count, bytes and the sha256 of its sorted "<relative path>\t<sha256>\n" lines. private-adapter-state/ is counted only, never hashed or published.
